candidates.title: Remove the structuredClone polyfill
candidates.reason: Native structuredClone could remove a runtime dependency and compatibility branch once every supported browser provides it.

candidates.title: Replace import-map examples with native import maps
candidates.reason: Native import maps could simplify the documented standalone bundle setup and remove its external shim.

candidates.title: Remove the :where() selector fallback
candidates.reason: Native :where() support could remove duplicate fallback selectors and generated CSS.

candidates.title: Remove hidden=until-found compatibility guards
candidates.reason: Universal hidden=until-found support could simplify find-in-page behavior, but accessibility and state synchronization still require human review.
